text: Economic Development Advisory Commission Agenda Regular Meeting Agenda September 10, 2026 The Economic Development Advisory Commission is a citizen commission appointed by the Fremont City Council. Economic Development Advisory Commission business is conducted in a public forum and operates within the rules and provisions of the Brown Act. Information on the Brown Act may be obtained from the City Clerk’s office at 3300 Capitol Avenue, (510) 284-4060. General Order of Business 6.1 Overview of The City of Fremont’s Legislative Affairs program aimed to provide direction to staff and the City's legislative advocates in Sacramento and Washington, D.C. Order of Discussion Generally, the order of discussion after introduction of an item by the chair will include comments and information by staff followed by Economic Development Advisory Commission questions, inquiries, or discussion. The applicant, authorized representative or interested citizens may then speak on the item. At the close of public discussion, the Commission will consider the item and action will be taken. Public Communications Any person desiring to speak on a matter that is not scheduled on this agenda may do so under Public Communications. The Economic Development Advisory Commission will take no action on an item which does not appear on the agenda. The item will be agendized for the next regular meeting or at a special meeting called in accordance with the terms of the Brown Act. The Economic Development Advisory Commission may establish time limits of presentations. Information September 10, 2026 AGENDA – Economic Development Advisory Commission Regular scheduled meetings of the Economic Development Advisory Commission are conducted at City Hall, 3300 Capitol Avenue, Building A, Ardenwood Room. Meetings are typically held at 9:00 a.m. on the first Thursday of January, March, May, July, September, and November. Meetings may be tape-recorded at the discretion of the Chair. Copies of the Agenda are available at the City Manager’s Office five days preceding the regularly scheduled meeting. Information about the City or items scheduled on the Agenda may be referred to: Donovan Lazaro, Economic Development Director 3300 Capitol Avenue Fremont, CA 94538 Telephone: (510) 284-4024 Your interest in the City’s business environment is appreciated.
